src: Mechanical Failure: Gate can not be opened.
Have you come to join me? Join me?
Two of them came by a long time ago. Long time ago.
I remember them, because they were the first survivors. First survivors.
But I have not seen them since. Not seen them since.
This is my room. My room.
It is where I stay to do the Hierarchs bidding. His bidding.
I do as he tells me. As he tells me.
Why are you talking like this?
I have been here for a long time. Long time.
The Hierarch sent me, to take care of this floor. This floor.
He sends me food every week. Every week.
But I have not seen many people since. Many people.
My lack of interaction must make me sound odd. Sound odd.
By the Hierarch, a survivor. Survivor.
This place used to be a factory. A place the machines used for replication.
So much of their power, concentrated in this place.
Imagine if we used their own powers against them.
This is why I have conquered this place.
This is why I gather the strong.
The next exam awaits you now. Good luck.
What is taking you so long? So long?
Seems like the Hierarch didn't do a good job during the creation.
So this thing is even more of a blight on the Hierarchs honor? More of a blight?
Even more reason to kill it. Kill it.
You can help him yourself. Help him.
And you also took care of the other one too. The other one.
I couldn't be more happy. More happy.
There is just one more issue. One issue.
We have another eyesore right over there. Over there.
Please take care of that too. Take care.
I'm done with the other one too.
I am very grateful for your service. For your service.
You are new here. New here.
Yet you have already done something amazing. Amazing.
You got rid of the eyesores. The eyesores.
I could not be happier. Could not.
You got rid of the eyesore. The eyesore.
Though there is one more. One more.
You should remove it too. Remove it.
The beauty of the Hierarch should not be tainted by it. Not be tainted.
Can you do me a favour? Favour?
You see this room here. This room.
There's an eyesore inside. An eyesore.
We need to get rid of it. Get rid of it.
That is even more reason to kill it. More reason to kill.
You can help him yourself. Help him.
I don't know how else to call it. How else to call it.
It just came here from upstairs. From upstairs.
We then captured it and put it in here. In here.
The others are saying the Hierarch created it. The Hierarch created it.
The Hierarch only creates perfection. Perfection.
You have come back. Come back.
What are you waiting for? Waiting for?
The eyesore is in that small room over there. Over there.
Well, the other eyesore is now gone.
I could not be more happy. More happy.
The Hierarch is untainted once again. Once again.
You wanted to help that thing. Help.
And yet it is gone. It is gone.
You must be completely useless. Useless.
You are trying to help that thing. That thing.
You know this won't make the Hierarch happy. The Hierarch.
Help me get rid of the eyesore in this room. The eyesore.
No, I need to help him.
You are trying to help that thing. That thing.
Do you have anything, that could help?
Why would I help you with this? With this?
The eyesore needs to go. Needs to go.
But he's made by the Hierarch, isn't he?
This here might help. Might help.
But I am not that sure if it really will. Not that sure.
I can give you this. Give you this.
I am sure it will work. It will work.
I'm looking for pain reliever ingredients.
Do you have anything, that could help?
There's another one like you over there.
Look, I brought you a pain reliever.
This person outside wants me to kill you.
Yes. We cyborgs are his creation.
He is taking in us feeble humans, and augmenting us.
So we can join him in his fight against the machine when the time is right.
Why aren't you repeating yourself when talking?
You mean like the supervisors you met on your way up, or the scientists in here?
I'm a cyborg. A former piece of flesh and bones, augmented and improved by the Hierarch.
They on the other hand are still raw humans.
The Hierarch chose them to serve him.
Cyborg guard for the one and only Hierarch.
Cluvo is always telling the truth.
You have the key. Give it to me!
Oh no. I'm sorry, but you are wrong.
Give us a moment to reorganize, then try again.
Here take it, and hurry to the Hierarch.
He is surely eager to meet a newcomer.
Wait, I really don't have it.
Did you manage to get sneaky on me?
Apparently I don't have the key.
You ... you got the key? You're good.
At least I'm a bit stronger now.
Why aren't you repeating yourself when talking?
I'm not sure what you mean.
I mean, so many others in this tower do it.
Bann is always telling the truth. Please trust him.
You have the key. Give it to me!
I'm sorry, but you're wrong. I don't have it.
Please try again in a moment. Okay?
Wait, I really don't have it.
Oh wait... Did you take it from me?
I'm sorry, I don't have the key.
I'm sorry, I don't have the key.
Now off you go. Do whatever you want with it.
Yeah. The Hierarch gave me this chance, I took it, and here we are.
A lot stronger, and with a cozy job guarding this gate.
He said some stuff about an upcoming war too.
Why aren't you repeating yourself when talking?
Don't you dare compare me to those ... people.
"I'm saying a thing. Saying a thing."
That's why I'm standing guard out here, rather than being inside with the others.
If they just became cyborgs like us. How much more peaceful it could be.
I was hoping you'd tell me a bit more than just your name.
Are you looking for a fight?
Asger is always telling the truth.
You have the key. Give it to me!
Try again later, if you think you can still do it.
Figured it out, huh? Or were you just guessing?
Now take the key, and go inside.
You stole it from my pocket, didn't you.
Well, if you already have it, move on.
Well done getting the key, human.
Do not be afraid of me, human.
I was once like you, human.
Why aren't you repeating yourself when talking?
I am distancing myself from human speech patterns.
I shall not repeat myself like those humans.
I am beyond your and their comprehension.
Door guard under the Great Hierarch.
Well done getting the key, fellow cyborg.
You have the key. Give it to me!
I do not have the key.
You must have used covert tactics to take it from me.
Congratulations on finding such an improbable solution.
I do not have the key.
I do not have the key.
I do not have the key.
While searching for the key, every one of the guards will either always tell you the truth, or always lie.
If you guess wrong, we'll switch it around.
